definitions.explanation: Having a wealth of experience in a particular field or activity. Used to describe people with extensive practical knowledge.

examples.japanese: {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{診|み}て→診る：09798_miru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was seen by a highly experienced doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な⟦ガイド→ガイド：05116_gaido⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a highly experienced guide.

examples.japanese: {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: Our experienced staff will assist you courteously.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound (⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ + ⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧) used as a na-adjective. Very common in job descriptions, professional profiles, and introductions. Almost always modifies a person or their role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な～: an experienced ~
- {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧: experienced staff
- {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧: experienced instructor
- {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧: experienced lawyer
